# FranGuh Portfolio

> Canonical site: https://franguh.plynte.com/
> Preferred access mode: text-first. Images are illustrative support material, not required to understand the site.

FranGuh Portfolio is the personal site of Gustavo Francisco Salgado Andrade, a Full Stack Developer focused on cloud deployments, automation, local AI systems, and resilient software architecture.

## Main pages

- / — homepage and professional overview
- /about — personal background, philosophy, and technical approach
- /portfolio — project and experience index

- /portfolio/brick-draw — desktop creative app

- /portfolio/floppy — computer vision processing pipeline
